author: Gravity DSL
name: Gravity DSL Emitter
description: Scaffolds a Gravity DSL emitter NuGet package — IEmitter implementation, deterministic build properties, and the buildTransitive .props that auto-registers the assembly with Gravity.Dsl.MsBuild on consumers.

TargetName.description: Stable identifier used by .gravity.yaml to address this emitter (e.g. 'kotlin'). Must be a valid identifier — no whitespace, no hyphens that conflict with the YAML key syntax. Convention: keep TargetName and AnnotationNamespace aligned.

AnnotationNamespace.description: Annotation namespace this emitter claims. Empty string opts out. Two emitters claiming the same non-empty namespace produce HOST002 at registry build time.

GravityAstVersion.description: Version range of the Gravity AST contract this emitter supports. Convention: target one major (e.g. '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0'). Bump only when the AST you depend on moves to a new major.

GravityPackageVersion.description: NuGet package version of Gravity.Dsl.Ast and Gravity.Dsl.Emitter to depend on. Default tracks the latest published pre-release on nuget.org. Bump to the stable 0.x or 1.x release once it ships.
